title: Historical wheel result through the workspace
summary: Exact retained failed native run, saved outputs and file tabs; no active vendor panel or process replay.

manualSteps.label: Workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace and click Workflows.

manualSteps.label: History
manualSteps.instruction: Open its saved workflow link with printDemoRun identifying the retained failed run.

manualSteps.label: Return
manualSteps.instruction: Click Back to workflow, then View saved result.

manualSteps.label: Saved record
manualSteps.instruction: Click Open saved run record and inspect its workspace file tab.

steps.label: Shared authoring entry
steps.summary: Established workflow editor remains; the active vendor demo entry is absent.
steps.expected: Editor controls without active print demo.
steps.actual: Editor controls present; Print a part demo absent.

steps.label: Exact read-only history
steps.summary: Historical link shows the retained failed run and eleven saved outputs without device controls.
steps.expected: Exact failed run, original error and saved outputs; no print controls.
steps.actual: Exact retained failed run/error and artifact links verified.

steps.label: Return to its editor
steps.summary: History returns to the same saved workflow.
steps.actual: Exact workflow editor and history reopen control visible.

steps.label: Reopen saved history
steps.summary: History reopens without preparing or executing a new process.

steps.label: Saved record in a workspace tab
steps.summary: The exact recorder file opens in Wright’s file tabs.

steps.actual: Exact saved recorder file tab selected.
